mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate rising above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal broad demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations decline over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in 60%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.5% year-over-year indicates easing supply constraints and expanding corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods with INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth above its 3-month moving average indicates sustained consumer spending strength, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that delays Fed rate cuts, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and unemployment rate signal labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day returns in 60%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,300 thousand units signals robust residential construction that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when HOUST > 1300.
